1: Dusk on a bare windswept hilltop above a grey sea, a faint flat coast on the horizon: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn, patched soldier's doublet and a faded travelling cloak, a small bundle over his shoulder, standing alone beside a stone quay, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, grave and quiet, looking out to sea. Hard low light from the side, mist on the water. Nobody else in the shot.
3: Dusk on the great stone walls of a sixteenth-century North African port fortress under construction: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn, patched doublet with rolled sleeves, bends under a heavy wooden hod of stone on his back, climbing a rough wooden ramp; his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, tired and patient. Skewed angular walls and scaffolding, hard low light from the side, drifting dust. Nobody else in the shot.
5: A narrow sixteenth-century Andalusian lane of whitewashed houses at morning, skewed angular rooftops, long hard shadows. a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn, patched dark doublet and a faded travelling cloak, a heavy canvas pack of books and rolled pictures on his back, walks slowly down the lane toward the camera, his face clearly visible, gentle and weary. Nobody else in the shot.
6: A lonely stony road in the Andalusian hills at dusk: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn, patched dark doublet and a faded travelling cloak, a heavy pack of books on his back, has stopped on the road and sinks to his knees, face lifted, clearly visible in three-quarter view, astonished and still; a single beam of soft hard-edged light falls from the cloudy sky onto the empty road in front of him. Mist in the hollows. Nobody else in the shot, no figures in the light.
8: The cobbled lane of a sixteenth-century Granada market in morning light, with the dark towers of the Alhambra hill behind: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet and a faded cloak, stands behind a small wooden stall laden with books and rolled pictures, arranging them, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, quietly hopeful. Skewed angular rooftops, long hard shadows, drifting mist. No other people.
